overview: Wildix PBX uses API key (Bearer token) authentication. You generate an API token from the Wildix PBX admin panel and include it as a Bearer token in every API request.

steps.title: Log in to Wildix PBX admin panel
steps.description: Access your Wildix PBX admin interface at https://{your-pbx-domain}/admin.

steps.title: Generate an API token
steps.description: Navigate to Settings → API Tokens (or Integrations → API). Create a new token with the required permissions. Copy the generated token.
steps.warning: Copy the token immediately after generation.

steps.title: Note your PBX domain
steps.description: Your Wildix PBX domain is the hostname/IP where your PBX is accessible, e.g. pbx.yourcompany.com. This is required as connection config.

steps.title: Create the connection
steps.tip: Use a unique connection_id per PBX instance.

tips: Wildix PBX must be network-accessible from the Nolixan backend — ensure firewall rules allow it.
Rotate API tokens periodically for security.
Wildix API supports real-time events via webhooks for call tracking.
